title: Mar Yuḥanǝn
source_text:
Omaṇṇux? 
Hano u+qadišayḏan Mar Yuḥanǝn,  Mar Yuḥánǝnwa.  
I+qaraqole maḥatla ak+kefayḏa  ʕal qarʕe d Mar Yuḥanǝn.  
Maḥatla ak+kefe ʕal Mar Yuḥanǝn, zəbṭowa nawba. 
Qām aṯi u+muxtā̀r, qreleli omar, ‘Nəʕman!’ 
Omaṇṇo, ‘Mənyo?’ 
Omar, ‘Tux! 
Kəmmi, maḥatte kefe ʕal u+qadišo, kozəbṭi nawba ʕal u+qadišo, kosaymi pisitiye ʕal u+qadišo. 
Itúx, zananne’. 
Azzano – ono ŭ ḥoli, ono ŭ u+muxtā̀r, azzano lsu+baščawī́š.  
Məḷḷan lu+baš, ǝmmina,  ‘Qomutā́n, kǝbʕina d… maḥatlux ak+kefani, dǝmḥalqatte’.  
Omar, ‘Lo+gəmḥalaqnanne’.  
Lǝ+mḥalqile, lǝ+mḥalqile. 
Aṯina li+ʕito. 
Əmmina, ‘Kal kazzán l Asṭǝl, məǧġolina tre+xabre ʕam ḥḏoḏe, aḥna ŭ hat’. 
ŭ nafiqina. 
ʕAbirina li+dərto du+qadišo, u+muxtā̀r omar,  ‘Kwīš bayto dbabux! 
Ma lmənhat? 
Ma míṯohat? 
Ma mənhat?’ 
Bdele ebe bi+dərto.
Qām hawi ʕam nhoroṯe.  
Naqqa lu+qadišawo Mar Yuḥanǝn mədle  ʕaskar  du+nobačì. 
Mədle lu+ʕaskarawo, mi+anišk̇e  di+gorayo mḥalaqle, xud dǝmḥalqat ltāmhe. 
Mḥalaqle ltamhenik̇é u+ʕaskar, mḥalaqle ltamo.
Noše bări mini lazzeyo, azzí ono qamayto aʕle. 
Ono siporčíwayno, roháṭwayno marke, mḥaláqwayno raġli ltamhenik̇é, roháṭwayno. 
Azzino ʕal riše,  kal komigambal,  twīr qarʕe, mpalpax qarʕe, ŭ ʕayne tavda ŭ druʕone.  
Maqlabli hawxa, hneli, ŭ aṯi ḥreno, ṭayo mʕawalleli. 
Ḥəḷḷan, kalé gmōṯ. 
Aṯyo i+ṭayara, i+ʕalikòptere, aṯyo, mədde, mḥalaqqe li+ʕalikòptere ŭ māṯ. 
Māṯ, mballe lu+bayto du+babayḏe. 
U+qadišayḏan Mar Yuḥanǝn háwxayo. 
Hawxa bi+dùkṯoyo. 
Šqilan sʕore, eli ŭ Nadimo ŭ lu+Galle d Be+Barṣo, Ăloho mḥasele. 
U+Galle d Be+Barṣo zlām ṭáwwowa, Ăloho mḥasele. 
Azzano, šqilan sʕore. 
Əmmina, ‘Gəblinanne l Mar Yuḥanǝn’. 
Kətwa … u+braxwàyḏiwa,  ḥoṯi i+kalàyḏewa, u+Ḥanna, Muqsi  Ḥanna  d Be+Mado, əmmíwayle Muqsi Ḥanna, d Be+Mado. 
Omar, ‘Ḥayra, lǝ+blutu a+sʕoraṯxu l Mar Yuḥanǝn, lə+gmaqbal’.  
U+Nadimo omar, ‘waḷḷáh Kam ê bǝbǝn , Ălah gǝblinanne’. 
Qām mballe, qrelan ltre+ṭaye, ʕAzizo kəmmile, ŭ Ṭáhǝro.  
Húlanne kallawat ḥaq dəṯṯe ŭ maṭʕanne ak+kise, azzano. 
Ínaqqa dazzano su+qadišo, u+qadišo hǧə́mlelan. 
Ele ŭ šawʕo+ḥrene, tmányowayne, baš+šurat,  bas+sayfe, hǧə́mmallan. 
Hǧə́mmallan, mahzamlan. 
Mḥalaqqe ak+kise, l Ṭáhəro ŭ l ʕAzizo mḥalaqqe ak+kise, ŭ l Nadimo mahzamle. 
Nadímoste ṭáyowa, mahzamle háwostene. 
Mahzamle l Nadimo, ono hedi hedi aṯino, omaṇṇo, ‘Ḥayra, Ălah, lə+gmaǧrina’. 
As+sayfaṯṯe, kul sayfo kə́pwayle  haqqask̇e  biḏoṯayye, xurxur  dəṯṯe. 
ŭ mahzamlan’.  
Aṯina lu+bayto. 
Qām u+Ḥaǧi, u+šuferàyḏanwa, u+Ḥaǧi omar, ‘Lawo waki wǝlo ya, waki háwxayo, lawo, lǝ+blutǝnne ltamo, ḥētne harke, bi+odaṯe’. 
Qām u+Muqsi, omar, ‘Ma lo+məḷḷǝlxu?’ 
Muqsi Ḥanna, ‘Lo+məḷḷǝlxu? 
Məḷḷi, lǝ+blūtne, lo+gmaqbal Mar Yuḥanǝn. 
Mar Yuḥanǝn lǝ+gmaqbal ṫaʕada. 
Ḥētne bi+odaṯe’. 
Qām maḥtilan bi+odayo. 
Hawxa səmle Mar Yuḥanǝn eban, lo+ṭrele dmaḥtina a+sʕorayḏan ebe.
